problems.issue: The date range 100/101 is correct, but the certainty should reflect the 'ut videtur' (as seen) in the text.
The normalized name 'Titus Pomponius Bassus' is correct but not explicitly given in the text. The text only mentions 'T. Pomponii Bassi'.
